# `@videojs/spf/hls/features/text-tracks`

Source: [src/playback/engines/hls/features/text-tracks.ts](../../../src/playback/engines/hls/features/text-tracks.ts)

## textTracksFeature

Adds the source's subtitle and caption renditions to the media element as text tracks and loads the WebVTT cues of
the showing one. Honors the user's `userTextTrackSelection`, including `'off'`.

Requires, from other features:

- A writer of `state.currentTime`, such as `currentTimeFeature`; without one, cue loading stops after the first window.
- A writer of `state.loadActivated`, such as `initialLoadFeature`, or a seeded `loadActivated: true`.

Content whose timestamps don't start at zero also needs `shiftTextTimestampsFeature`, or its cues are misaligned.

### Behaviors

1. [resolveTextTrack](../behaviors/resolve-track.md#resolvetexttrack)
2. [switchTextTrack](../behaviors/track-switching.md#switchtexttrack)
3. [syncTextTracks](../behaviors/dom/sync-text-tracks.md#synctexttracks)
4. [setupTextTrackActors](../behaviors/dom/setup-text-track-actors.md#setuptexttrackactors)
5. [loadTextTrackSegments](../behaviors/dom/load-segments.md#loadtexttracksegments)
6. `defineExternalSignals<UserTrackSelectionState<'text'>>()({ state: ['userTextTrackSelection'] })`
